dedupe_keys.name: big area additive manufacturing electricity use

description: The BAAM electricity-use research team publishes an Excel workbook describing electricity use in Big Area Additive Manufacturing of fibre-reinforced polymer composites. The Figshare repository supplies a revised workbook released in November 2024, with public access at no cost under CC BY 4.0. Experimental coverage concerns this manufacturing process, not a representative national industrial-demand survey. The observations can calibrate process-energy assumptions and manufacturing demand profiles used in electricity-capacity simulations with model-pypsa. A caveat is that material choice, print geometry, equipment settings and supporting processes can change energy use. The repository landing page provides limited variable-level documentation, so workbook labels must be examined before assigning units or separating production and auxiliary loads. No workbook cells, job counts or acquisition intervals were verified by downloading the data.
